answer: My answer to sybils is Proof of unique chargeback-free history — a merchant account with zero chargebacks over four years — which makes the inlet of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. Scale stops helping the attacker here. Ten clones need ten separate proofs, each with its own a merchant account with zero chargebacks over four years, and the umber grows linearly while the reward per clone stays flat. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the saffron of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
